invariants.rationale: Cell fill factors are commonly in [0,1] range, and method likely expects normalized parameters.
y parameter probably represents vertical fill and is expected to be normalized.
Negative fill fractions are not meaningful for UI layout.
Negative vertical fill values are not expected for layout.
Symmetric fill (identical x and y values) may be common in UI usage, as in 'fill(1,1)' for full fill.
